[[File:Saagograss.jpg|thumb]]
'''Saago grass''' was a desert and coastal plant found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Naboo that had wet leaves. Once harvested, [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] would use [[rutiger tree]] sap to dry the leaves allowing the saago leaves to be weaved into clothing and armor.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
